integrity: The included Python checks are finite corroboration of a self-contained infinite proof, not formal or independent certification.
scientific_limitations: The period theorem concerns odd prime-power moduli with exponent at least two and primitive-root bases. Prime-modulus and base-2 reciprocal-period subfamilies are known; its distinct assertion is uniform for every primitive base. Nonprimitive bases and general odd composite moduli are not classified. Classical d-sequence literature might contain an implicit equivalent prime-power statement, and independent literature validation is outstanding.
title: Exact primitive periods for prime-power Diophantine solvability words
